FWS.menuHint: Configure the webhook, server address and ONLINE/OFFLINE messages for the active game world.
FWS.intro: Send your active game world's status to Discord with one click.
FWS.securityHint: A webhook is an access key. Stored only in this browser, separately for each world and GM. Set up other browsers separately.
FWS.tooltipOff: Announce the game world as ONLINE on Discord
FWS.tooltipOn: Announce the game world as OFFLINE on Discord
FWS.onlineSent: The game world has been announced as ONLINE on Discord.
FWS.offlineSent: The game world has been announced as OFFLINE on Discord.
FWS.offlineLocal: The world status has been set to OFFLINE.
FWS.shutdownConfirm: There are still {number} other users connected. Announce the world as OFFLINE on Discord and close it?
FWS.shutdownBusy: A Discord action is running or has just finished. Wait a moment, then select Return to Setup again.
FWS.shutdownStopped: Automatic shutdown has been stopped. Check the error or disable the automatic OFFLINE announcement to close without it.
FWS.testHint: The test sends a real message using the webhook URL currently entered. You do not need to save first. The ON/OFF status stays unchanged.
FWS.testFailed: The Discord webhook could not be reached.
FWS.previewHint: Approximate text preview. Discord Markdown, avatars and images are not rendered here. External images are only passed to Discord when sending.

fields.sendOffline: Send an OFFLINE Message to Discord
fields.autoOfflineOnShutdown: Announce OFFLINE before Return to Setup

hints.webhookUrl: HTTPS webhook from Discord → Edit Channel → Integrations. Stored only in this browser; keep it private.
hints.serverUrl: Publicly reachable address starting with https:// or http://. Required for ONLINE.
hints.username: Display name of the announcement; up to 80 characters.
hints.avatarUrl: Optional. Publicly reachable image URL using http:// or https://.
hints.sendOffline: When disabled, the second click only sets the saved status to OFF.
hints.autoOfflineOnShutdown: Only before attempting to close the world through Return to Setup, with status ON and OFFLINE messages enabled. Logging out does not change the world status. Does not monitor the server or browser. Sending errors stop shutdown. Default: off.
hints.onlineDescription: Discord Markdown is supported. Description and appended server link combined: up to 4096 characters.
hints.onlineLinkText: Optional. Leave empty to display the server URL. Up to 254 characters.
hints.onlineColor: Color of the embed's left border.
hints.onlineImage: Optional. Publicly reachable URL for the large embed image.
hints.offlineColor: Color of the embed's left border.
hints.content: ONLINE only. Optional; up to 2000 characters including the role mention. @everyone and user mentions are disabled.
hints.roleId: Optional: 17–20 digits. This role is automatically mentioned for ONLINE. Typing an @RoleName does not create a role mention.

errors.gmOnly: Only GMs can send the world status to Discord.
errors.webhook: Enter a valid Discord webhook in the module settings first.
errors.server: Enter a valid Foundry Server URL using http:// or https:// (up to 1024 characters).
errors.url: Use valid image URLs starting with http:// or https://.
errors.color: Enter a valid embed color in #RRGGBB format.
errors.role: The Discord Role ID must contain 17 to 20 digits.
errors.contentLength: Additional Discord text and the role mention may contain up to 2000 characters combined.
errors.embedLength: A Discord embed may contain up to 6000 text characters in total. Shorten the title, description, footer or link.
errors.badRequest: Discord rejected the message (HTTP 400). Check the embed content, URLs and thread ID if used.
errors.unauthorized: Discord access is not authorized (HTTP 401). Check or recreate the webhook.
errors.forbidden: Discord denied access (HTTP 403). Check the webhook and channel permissions.
errors.notFound: The Discord webhook or target channel was not found (HTTP 404). Update the webhook URL.
errors.rateLimit: Discord's rate limit was reached (HTTP 429). Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.http: The Discord request failed (HTTP {status}). Try again later.
errors.network: The GM's browser could not read a response from Discord. Check the network/DNS, TLS, browser extensions and CORS; a Content Security Policy must allow the Discord host in connect-src. Docker alone does not explain this error. Before retrying, check the Discord channel to see whether the message arrived.
errors.timeout: Discord did not respond in time. Before clicking again, check whether the message arrived in the channel.
errors.confirmation: Discord did not clearly confirm delivery. Before clicking again, check whether the message arrived in the Discord channel.
errors.stateAfterSend: The Discord message was sent, but the status could not be saved. Do not resend; check the Foundry connection and permissions first.
errors.stateSave: The Discord status could not be saved. Check the Foundry connection and permissions.
errors.shutdownRequest: OFFLINE has already been announced, but Foundry did not clearly confirm that the world closed. It may still be open. Check the server status; no automatic ONLINE message will be sent.
errors.settingsSave: Settings were not fully saved. The local webhook may already have been saved. Check the Foundry connection and save again.
errors.unexpected: The Discord action could not be completed. Details without webhook data are available in the browser console.
errors.migrationRequired: The previously shared webhook URL must first be copied to local storage. Open the module settings again.
errors.migrationFailed: Webhook migration did not complete. Existing values have been kept. Check browser storage and the Foundry connection, then reopen the settings.
errors.migrationConflict: The local and shared webhooks differ. Nothing was overwritten or removed. Resolve the migration as described in the README.
errors.localStorage: Local webhook storage is unavailable. Check browser storage; world settings have been kept.
errors.onlineDescriptionLength: The ONLINE description and server link, including Discord Markdown, may contain up to 4096 characters combined. Shorten the description or link.
errors.languageLoad: The selected module language could not be loaded. Foundry's language is being used. Reopen the module settings to try again.

language.name: Language / Sprache
language.hint: Automatic uses Foundry's active interface language. German or English applies only to this user in this browser and world. Other users are unaffected.
